processes.title: Sell from Stock with Advanced Down Payment
processes.memory_hook: Collect cash before final delivery billing, but keep the sales flow intact.

sap_scope_items.label: Sell from Stock with Down Payment Processing

processes.business_intent: Extend sell-from-stock with down payment requests and later settlement against customer invoices.

control_plane.why: determines whether the sales item participates in ADP
links requested/received down payments to final settlement

data_hinges.changes: when and how much is requested
what can be settled against the final invoice
maximum relevant down-payment amount and settlement context

impact_summary: Adds a cash/receivables control layer before final delivery-related billing without turning the sales order into a separate financial process.
constraints: ADP cannot be combined with some billing features such as retroactive billing or reference billing plans.
Legal and tax handling is localization-sensitive.
lead_questions: Is the down payment a commercial requirement or a legal/tax requirement?
What should block fulfillment if payment is missing?
How is settlement traced to the final invoice?

processes.title: Milestone Billing with Advanced Down Payment
processes.memory_hook: Bill the project in stages; collect down payments against the same staged logic.

sap_scope_items.label: Sales Order Processing with Milestone Billing

processes.business_intent: Combine order-related milestone billing with advanced down payment requests for trading goods, non-stock products, or services where supported.

control_plane.control: billing plan type and milestone dates

control_plane.why: determines which sales items can use the process

data_hinges.changes: commercial exposure and remaining billable value

impact_summary: The process shifts the commercial clock from delivery events to agreed billing milestones, with down payments settled into that schedule.
constraints: The exact supported item categories and localization behavior are release-sensitive.
lead_questions: What business event proves a milestone?
What prevents the final invoice from ignoring earlier down payments?

processes.title: Bills of Material in Sales Documents
processes.memory_hook: One commercial item can explode into many fulfillment items.
processes.business_intent: Sell a structured product and decide whether pricing, inventory control, and delivery happen at main-item or component level.

control_plane.control: item category group ERLA vs LUMF

control_plane.why: decide pricing, delivery and delivery-group behavior

data_hinges.changes: where pricing, inventory and delivery relevance sit
correlated delivery date for the group

impact_summary: A BOM changes the unit of reasoning: availability of one component can delay the commercial kit even when other components are available.
constraints: Delivery-group correlation has prerequisites and cannot simply reconcile every partial/fixed-quantity scenario.
Sales-kit support in advanced intercompany has additional boundaries.
lead_questions: Is the customer buying one product or a bundle of independently fulfilled components?
Should one missing component block the group?
What happens to quantities when a component changes?

modes.title: Main-item processing
modes.memory: Main item owns price and logistics; components are informational

modes.title: Subitem processing
modes.memory: Components own delivery/inventory behavior; group correlation matters
